entries.title: Records Transmittal and Receipt
entries.preparedBy: Office that holds the records

requiredFacts.label: No active hold on the records

entries.note: The office sends the form to the records center and waits for its answer before shipping. The signed copy comes back as the receipt. NARA notes that new analog transfers stopped after 2024-06-30 unless an exception applies. The fact list is this project's reading of the public instructions. Check it against the current form.

entries.title: Notice of Eligibility for Disposal
entries.preparedBy: Federal Records Center, which sends the notice
entries.receivedBy: Agency records officer, who reviews it and responds

requiredFacts.label: Disposal date shown on the notice
No active hold on the records
Agency response recorded by a person

entries.note: The records center sends the notice about 90 days before the scheduled date and does not destroy records without the agency's written answer. This system only tracks the notice and the facts a reviewer needs. It never produces an answer to the notice.

entries.title: Agency Review for Contingent Disposal
entries.preparedBy: Federal Records Center
entries.note: The title was read on the forms page. The process behind it was not read.

entries.title: Request for Records Disposition Authority
entries.preparedBy: Agency records officer
entries.note: The agency asks NARA to agree a records schedule. The form title was read on NARA pages. How requests are submitted today was not checked.

entries.title: Agreement to Transfer Records to the National Archives of the United States
entries.preparedBy: Agency records officer
entries.note: Used for permanent records. The title was read in NARA documents. The current process was not checked.

entries.title: Reference Request
entries.preparedBy: Office that needs the records back
entries.note: Asks a records center to retrieve records it holds for the agency.

entries.title: Request for Disposition of Records
entries.preparedBy: VA office that holds the records
entries.note: The title was found only in an archived 2003 list of VHA publications. Whether the form is current, and how it is used, was not checked.

entries.title: Records Transmittal and Receipt (VA)
entries.preparedBy: VA office that holds the records
entries.note: Found only in a third party copy of a VA records center guide. Not read on a VA page.

entries.title: Senior Agency Official for Records Management annual report
entries.preparedBy: Senior Agency Official for Records Management
entries.note: One of three yearly submissions to NARA. The reporting window moves every year, so a person enters the due date.

entries.title: Records Management Self-Assessment
entries.preparedBy: Agency records officer
entries.note: Yearly survey about the agency's records program. The questions have not been mapped to anything in this system.

entries.title: Federal Electronic Records and Email Management report
entries.preparedBy: Agency records officer
entries.note: Yearly maturity model survey on electronic records and email.

entries.title: Corrective action plan entry
entries.preparedBy: Office responsible for the audit recommendation
entries.receivedBy: Agency audit follow-up official and the audit team
entries.note: OMB Circular A-50 was revised on 2024-11-07 under the title Audit, Inspection, or Evaluation Follow-Up. Only the transmittal was read. Timing rules inside the circular were not read, so this system shows no deadline of its own.

entries.title: Annual assurance statement on internal control
entries.preparedBy: Agency head, supported by each office's control review
entries.receivedBy: The President and the Congress, through the agency financial report
entries.note: Required each year under FMFIA, with OMB Circular A-123 as the guidance. A 2026 edition of A-123 exists and was not read in full. Read it before quoting any section.

entries.title: SSA Agency Financial Report: management assurances and audit summary
entries.preparedBy: Social Security Administration
entries.receivedBy: Published with the agency financial report
entries.note: The FY 2025 report carries a Management Assurances section and a Summary of Financial Statement Audit and Management Assurances.

entries.title: VA Agency Financial Report: assurance sections
entries.preparedBy: Department of Veterans Affairs
entries.receivedBy: Published with the agency financial report
entries.note: Listed as the VA counterpart of the SSA entry. The VA report was not read.

entries.title: Privacy impact assessment
entries.preparedBy: System owner with the agency privacy office
entries.note: Section 208 of the E-Government Act asks for one when a system that handles identifiable information is new or changes. OMB M-03-22 is the guidance.

entries.title: System of records notice
entries.preparedBy: Agency privacy office
entries.note: Published under the Privacy Act. OMB Circular A-108 covers publication and reporting.
